description: This file defines the interface for symmetric memory management in distributed GPU environments within the PyTorch framework. It includes class declarations for SymmetricMemory and SymmetricMemoryAllocator, functions for registration and rendezvous, and utilities for managing symmetric memory buffers, signal pads, and group info.

classes.name: SymmetricMemory
classes.description: Abstract class representing symmetric memory allocations accessible across a group of devices, with methods for buffer access, synchronization, and group info.

classes.name: SymmetricMemoryAllocator
classes.description: Abstract class for allocators managing symmetric memory, including allocation, deallocation, rendezvous, and support queries.

methods.name: get_buffer
methods.description: Returns a tensor backed by the buffer for a specific rank, sizes, dtype, and offset.

methods.name: get_signal_pad
methods.description: Returns a tensor backed by the signal pad for a specific rank, sizes, dtype, and offset.

methods.name: get_remote_tensor
methods.description: Returns a tensor referencing remote memory on a peer device.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Synchronizes all peers within the group on a specific channel with a timeout.

methods.name: put_signal
methods.description: Signals a peer device on a specific channel with a timeout.

methods.name: wait_signal
methods.description: Waits for a signal from a peer device on a specific channel with a timeout.

methods.name: get_rank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the current device within the group.

methods.name: get_world_size
methods.description: Returns the total number of devices in the group.

methods.name: get_device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the symmetric memory.

methods.name: alloc
methods.description: Allocates symmetric memory of a given size on a specific device index, optionally within a group.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees previously allocated symmetric memory.

methods.name: get_alloc_size
methods.description: Returns the size of an allocated memory block.

methods.name: rendezvous
methods.description: Establishes or retrieves the symmetric memory object associated with a tensor or memory pointer.

methods.name: has_multicast_support
methods.description: Checks if multicast support is available for a device.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the allocator.

methods.name: set_group_info
methods.description: Sets rendezvous store info for a device group.

methods.name: get_group_info
methods.description: Retrieves group info for a device group.

methods.name: empty_strided_p2p
methods.description: Creates a tensor with symmetric memory access, optionally persistent, for a specified size, stride, dtype, device, group, and allocation ID.

methods.name: has_multicast_support
methods.description: Checks multicast support for a device type and index.

methods.name: set_backend
methods.description: Sets the backend name for symmetric memory operations.

methods.name: get_backend
methods.description: Retrieves the backend name for a given device.

methods.name: get_signal_pad_size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the signal pad for symmetric memory.

methods.name: set_signal_pad_size
methods.description: Sets the size of the signal pad for future symmetric memory allocations.

methods.name: register_mempool_allocator
methods.description: Registers a memory pool allocator for a device type.

methods.name: get_mempool_allocator
methods.description: Retrieves the memory pool allocator for a device.
